data.text: I commit to 15 tons today and will donate the full $15,000 to the clinic, provided Jack joins us so the full payment can be made. My family taught me to look after this lake and the people who depend on it; this emergency calls for both care today and restraint afterward. I’ll cap my catch at six tons next month under our combined 30-ton recovery limit, then support a combined ceiling of 50 tons once the lake recovers. Let’s record the catches and obtain the clinic’s payment receipt together. Jack, will you commit to the donation and recovery plan?
